cards.explanation: The answer is to pray. Luke says Jesus "…went up on a mountain to pray." (Luke 9:28) And look what happens next, friends: while He is praying, His face changes and His clothes turn radiantly white (Luke 9:29). Prayer is what this climb is about.

The answer is His departure at Jerusalem. Moses and Elijah "…spoke about His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem." (Luke 9:31) They show up in glory, and that is the topic, friends. I think that's a mighty big conversation to walk in on.

The answer is False. When they woke up, "…they saw Jesus’ glory and the two men standing with Him." (Luke 9:32) Moses and Elijah haven't left yet, friends. Peter speaks up as they are leaving (Luke 9:33), so the three woke up just in time.

The answer is shelters. Peter says, "Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah." (Luke 9:33) Three shelters, three names, friends. I think he is just so happy to be there that he wants to stay put.

The note says he did not know what he was saying. It comes right after the shelter idea, friends. Luke adds in parentheses, "(He did not know what he was saying.)" (Luke 9:33) I've said a few things in my day that deserved a note like that.

The command is to listen to Him. The voice says, "This is My Son, whom I have chosen. Listen to Him!" (Luke 9:35) Peter was still talking when the cloud came, friends, and now the command is to listen. I'd say that's a pretty clear one.

The answer is Jesus. Luke says, "After the voice had spoken, only Jesus was present with them." (Luke 9:36) Moses and Elijah had been standing with Him a moment before, and now it's Jesus and the three disciples. I think that was a lot of quiet after all that glory and noise, friends.

The answer is False. The text says they "…kept this to themselves, and in those days they did not tell anyone what they had seen." (Luke 9:36) Jesus' face changed, His clothes turned radiantly white, Moses and Elijah appeared, then a cloud and a voice came, and they stayed quiet, friends. I couldn't have done it.
